blocks.html: Chapter 9’s tests assume a quantitative outcome with a roughly Normal distribution. This chapter covers what to use when that assumption fails or the outcome is not quantitative at all. §10.1–10.5 give the rank- and sign-based tests, one for each design in Chapter 9. §10.6–10.8 turn to counts in tables: the chi-square tests, the measures of risk and odds read from a 2 × 2 table, the exact test for small tables and the tests for paired binary data.
